steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: My fin-drying rack! My bed!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Laios!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Since when was Marcille this quick?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I think she's seeing us as the Red Dragon now!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Then what do we do?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Seeing how she only has Falin on her mind now, I should try...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Marcille! It's me, Laios! Falin's brother!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: No way! You're way too normal! Laios is the guy who'd intimidate a Basilisk with just a strange pose!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I mean, she's right.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Fine, if that's how it's gonna be!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: RAAAH—!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios... it really is you?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: That actually worked?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios! The Red Dragon ate Falin, we need to defeat it so we can revive her!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Wait, why are you pointing at me?! What part of me looks like a dragon?!

spans.text: Wait, why are you pointing at
?! What part of me looks like a dragon?!

steps.name: Chilchuck & Senshi
steps.text: Aagh!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: What's her problem?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Ghah—Are her eyes rolling about as she stumbles everywhere?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Yes!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Is she lashing out and babbling nonsense?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Yes, yes!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Foaming at the mouth?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Yes, yes, yes!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Then she's poisoned! Lucky for you, but also unlucky, the only one who knows how to make the antidote is the High Priest!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: All we have are Kbibi grass that we use as a general cure-all for poisonings, illness, or upset stomachs. You can try using them, but I can't guarantee it'll work.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Then... I'll hold Marcille down, while you guys go look for something to attract the High Priest!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: How? Where?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: A sumptuous feast ought to draw him in! She must be hallucinating, and if we don't hurry, she's going to blow my house up!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Chilchuck, go with the others! I'll handle it here!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Got it... we'll leave her to you!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Phew, that should be enough fruit and fish. Thanks for guiding me, friend. But could I trouble you with one more thing?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Fish? This is a fin.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Oh... so that's what you call them here. Anyhow, I'd like you to return to the village first and boil me a pot of water.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Water?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Aye, I just thought of something. A regular meal probably wouldn't be impressive enough, so I plan to make a huge stew!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: On one hand, consider it a thank you for everything you've done for us, and on the other, didn't you say the High Priest likes lively feasts?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Oh! You want to make a nice pot of stew? Great! I'll head back and get it started!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I have enough fruit and fish, but...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I still feel like something's missing...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Odd. Heard a strange noise and came over, but there's nothing here.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: And my 'Invincible Cool Thing' exploded too. My luck has been terrible today!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Fine, fine. I'll just go home and sleep it off!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: *Sigh* I wouldn't be out here all on my own if I hadn't promised Zumama I'd look after the research projects.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Plump and vibrant colors... A healthy bird. Let's check Bob's Gourmet Guide to see if its edible...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: 'Fowlbeasts are creatures covered with feathers that can fly. Edible, and delicious no matter how you cook them.'

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Hmm... this should make for the perfect main ingredient. Eye-catching too. I'm sure the High Priest will love it! This is it!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: (Why is there a Durin approaching me with a hungry look in his eyes?)

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: (Hm? Hold on. Is he really a Durin even?)

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: (...Ha, I see. How interesting.)

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: (Wait, it's been so long since I last played dead. How do you do it?)

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: SQUAAAAAWKKK!!!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: ...I don't think I hit it that hard?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Grk...guh...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Well, as long as its dead.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Chilchuck! Have ya gathered enough fruit? Let's head back!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Laios, I know you're Laios, but why do I keep thinking you look more like the dragon?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Marcille, let's talk about Falin instead.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Yeah, she's my best friend! And, listen to me, she's so happy that you're her brother, Laios. She really likes you and always talks about you.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Everyone else considered her a terrible student, but I disagree. I learned so many things from her! I... I love her!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But... but... I was too weak, so she... she got eaten by the dragon!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: ...It's not just your fault, Marcille.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: She's my sister, of course we're going to save her. I'll never give up.
However, Laios cannot help but feel a little curious: how exactly does everyone look in the eyes of the poisoned Marcille?
Does Senshi look like a short and stout dragon? Is Chilchuck a tiny one?
Should he go look for some of the same fruit to find out for himself?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: How's Marcille?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: She just fell asleep... They said it's how the body protects itself from the toxin, but it's still better to get the antidote sooner than later.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Good! I'll go get the stew started then, with this fatty bird I caught as the star of the broth!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I really hope this'll attract the High Priest...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Help me with the prep work and it'll be done sooner!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Check which way the wind is blowing... and build your fire downwind to avoid starting a forest fire.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Wash the fruits, mushrooms, and potatoes, then cut them into bite-sized chunks and put them aside.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Add some spices and Kbibi grass to the pot, and bring it to a boil so the meat will absorb the flavor better.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Then add the fruits and mushrooms for bringing out the umami taste, cook a few minutes more, then add the meat and potatoes.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Scale the fish, then slice open the belly and remove the organs. Wash the gills with running water or simply remove them with a knife.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Make diagonal cuts on the fish. Mix chili, pepper, salt, and lemon juice all together, then smear the mixture on the cuts...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Skewer them on clean branches and place them right by the campfire. Don't forget to rotate them now and then to ensure they're evenly cooked...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Now let's check back on our bird. When the broth starts to thicken, add some salt and have a little taste test!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Finally, simmer on low heat until that mouth-watering smell comes out...

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Mmmm, and it's done! A pot of stew for the High Priest!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: How do you usually get his attention?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Sing! Dance! Cheer! Feast! Then he'll show up naturally!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Alright, then let's dig in, everyone!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Mm, the fruit and mushrooms enrich the flavor along with the herbs' unique aroma. A good stew.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Ah... it smells so good...

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Sing! Dance! The High Priest won't come unless you get moving!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: O-Okay...!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: You too, Chilchuck and Senshi!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Uh... is the High Priest still not here yet?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: We'll have to use our ultimate method then. An earnest plea!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: High Priest! Delicious food awaits you, so please come!

steps.name: Chilchuck & Laios & Senshi
steps.text: ...High Priest! Delicious food awaits you, so please come!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Uggh...

steps.name: Fatty Bird & Vegetable Detox Stew
steps.text: Gukhh!!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Slurp... Mm... mm...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: *Gulp*

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: So warm...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I haven't had such a pleasant bath in a long time.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: But there are too many strange ingredients in here!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Half-cut lemons, sliced mushrooms, and cubed potatoes?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Chili pepper and Kbibi grass too, even!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Slurp... Mm... mm...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Mm... Ugh! It tastes weird!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Is this a medicinal bath?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh... it feels like my butt is being broiled... Reminds me of the heat inside the cockpit before the mech takes off... This really is quite pleasant...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I'll just soak it in and all the exhaustion from the explosion will disappear!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Th-The bird came back to life?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It revived in the stew? Could it be...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: ...Oh, is it an 'undying monster'?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: High Priest! What are you doing inside the pot?!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: HIGH PRIEST?! This bird?? He was here the whole time?!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Ew... so that broth was his bath water?!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Ugh! I just drank some!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: (Oh... I wonder what the undead taste like...)

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Yes, I'm the High Priest!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: And during my bath, I figured out what you all want from me!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Seeing how your companion is poisoned, I will certainly not sit idly by!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I don't remember mentioning that...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Ahem! To cure your companion...

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: The best method is to drink this medicinal bath water!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I bet even a crazy feral wolf would come to its senses after having such a disgusting stew!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: D-Disgusting?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: If it's bad, I'm sure it's the main ingredient's fault.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Since the High Priest has spoken, please have your companion try the blessed stew!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ugh... *Gulp*...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What a strange taste...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...Urgh... it's so noisy...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Great! The High Priest Stew really worked!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: High Priest... Stew?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Oh no!
Marcille struggles to open her eyes—
A monster that can speak! And still alive! The monster is currently sipping the soup in the pot, which shares the same aroma as the bowl of stew before her.
At the same time, Laios already has spoon in hand, and goes in for a quick scoop, sending it straight to his mouth.
Marcille licks her lips, finally comes back to her senses, and lets out a shriek—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: M-MONSTER?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: AHHHHH—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I DON'T WANT IT—

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'M SICK OF EATING MONSTERS!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Heh, the stew's pretty good.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Hahaha! You need your tastebuds checked, my boy!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: High Priest...?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Shh! I know what you want to know! I already have the gist of what's happened... Hmm, I see, but it's not the time yet.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: The time? For what?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh, nothing... You're looking for Rhodes Island, yes?

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Yes, Rhodes Island can help you!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: You're moving in the right direction! Just carry on as you have!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Huh? He's gone? Again?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: He said we were heading in the right direction? Sounded to me like a whole bunch of nonsense...

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: ...Because we're not even heading in any particular direction!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: So, Marcille... why did you eat the fruit?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: ...They looked like raspberries.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Raspberries?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: When I first met Falin, she offered me some. So when I found fruit here that looked exactly the same...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I thought they were raspberries too, and there was a little bird eating them, so I took two...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Well, you can tell her what happened later.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Yeah, and about all the trouble you caused while you had food poisoning!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ugh, enough of that!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Let's continue our search for Rhodes Island!
